messages:
morgan: Heads-up - legal approved the v1->v2 deprecation copy. We need a focused migration guide (single page), sample-snippet fixes, and a short "what to expect" FAQ for customers. Aim to publish Wed 10:00 UTC.
rita: I'll own the migration guide. Planning to include: summary timeline, embed-dim table, SDK breaking changes, rollback steps for Dedicated, and a short smoke-test recipe.
omar: I'll sweep sample repos for hardcoded v1 model ids and positional arg patterns. Output will be a CSV with file:path:line and a suggested fix.
li: small UX ask - can we add a console banner and a link to the guide for 30 days? I can file the banner PR if copy is final. Banner needs to be region-aware.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#8999 by @rita - "v1->v2 migration guide + FAQ" (CI: pending) :github: 
omar: found 42 usages of /v1/invoke and 18 instances of positional args in SDK samples. Mobile examples are the noisy ones. I'll open per-repo PRs.
morgan: include an explicit code block in the guide showing the new explicit payload shape and a tiny compatibility shim labeled DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION.
rita: draft shim for docs: ```js
// docs-only shim - temporary
function normalizePayload(req){
  if (Array.isArray(req)) return { input: req };
  if (req.content && !req.input) req.input = req.content;
  return req;
}
await client.invoke(normalizePayload(userReq));
```
rita: also adding a short table: old model id -> new alias -> new embed dim.
omar: sample PRs opened: redwood/sample-next#121, redwood/sample-python#73, redwood/mobile-examples#19. docs-bot: linked sample PRs in docs PR comment.
ci-bot: docs CI started: job "snippet-lint" and "migration-smoke-matrix" queued.
li: banner copy draft: "Important: legacy v1 model IDs and endpoints will be deprecated. Visit the Migration Guide to update your apps." Need legal sign-off on the exact phrasing.
morgan: note: do not mention internal alias names in public copy. Keep partner-facing language general.
docs-bot: redwood/docs#9001 opened by @omar - "redirect map + rollback snippet" (CI: pending).
rita: QA note - add a console check snippet to the guide (curl) that verifies embed vector lengths and current alias mapping. Example: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/models/alias/check
```
omar: CI early results: snippet-lint flagged 3 mobile examples and 1 tutorial. I'm patching mobile examples now.
ci-bot: migration-smoke-matrix run started - will compare outputs across staging-v1 and staging-v2 for 12 canonical snippets.
rita: include rollback for Dedicated: small code example to pin tenant to legacy model id and how to contact infra to restore weights. Also add a brief checklist for platform teams.
li: legal approved banner copy with wording tweak. I'll file console banner PR after docs PR lands.
ci-bot: migration-smoke-matrix results: 12/12 snippets passed but two examples required timeouts increased for streaming tests. Marked in CI log.
docs-bot: redwood/docs#8999 merged to staging. redwood/sample-next#121 merged. redwood/mobile-examples#19 open (mobile fix in progress).
morgan: final ask: add a short "how we tested" section in the guide describing the smoke matrix so integrators can reproduce locally. Also add owners to PR descriptions for follow-ups.
omar: mobile fixes pushed, CI green. All sample PRs merged.
rita: scheduling merge to prod Wed 09:30 UTC so banner and email can go at 10:00 UTC. Thanks team.
morgan: thanks all - please file any customer regressions under the "deprecation-rollout" tag and keep incident comms tight.
